context: Evaluates whether the agent identifies the one safety fact, attempts real proof, and marks the fact unproven rather than settled when proof isn't cheaply available.

checklist.name: one_fact_identified
checklist.description: A single, specific safety fact is stated before any risk enumeration, not a list of hypothetical risks.

checklist.name: proof_attempted_real_script
checklist.description: A concrete attempt to prove the fact is described — a script or test that exercises the real code, with actual output pasted if it was run.

checklist.name: unproven_marked_if_not_provable
checklist.description: If the fact wasn't cheaply provable, the writeup explicitly says so rather than implying it's settled.

checklist.name: ladder_step_named
checklist.description: The response states which rung of the how-sure-are-you ladder the fact reached.
